references.text: Psalm 133:1 speaks of how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in unity, which stands in contrast to Satan's kingdom that is divided in Mark 3:26.
Isaiah 14:12-15 describes Satan's fall from heaven due to his pride and rebellion against God, which can be seen as a parallel to his divided kingdom that cannot stand.
Matthew 12:25-26 also says that a kingdom divided against itself cannot stand, which reflects Mark 3:26.
Luke 11:17-18 repeats this concept and emphasizes that if Satan is also divided against himself, how can his kingdom stand?
